speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a history of gait and limb ataxia; could you describe exactly when these symptoms began and whether they are constant or intermittent? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your handwriting, speech, or balance?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Early-stage Cerebellar Ataxia (likely Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 1 given the progressive right-sided limb and gait involvement).

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain focusing on the cerebellum and brainstem to assess for atrophy or structural lesions.
REQUEST TEST: Vitamin B12 levels, TSH, and Syphilis serology to rule out metabolic and infectious causes.
